scope.staleLockDisposition: No duplicate concurrent stale-lock case was added: packages/gateway/test/broker-supervisor.test.ts verifies that a dead-pid lock removes only stale remnants, preserves agent/sessions/saved-session-1/transcript.json, and permits start. Generation 6 also reviews the atomic-rename reclaim fix, which prevents a losing concurrent reclaimer from unlinking a newly recreated live lock.
scope.testPolicy: The required gateway full suite, credentialed live E2E, TypeScript check, subsession diff check, and gjc version check were each run exactly once. The retained Gen5 broker health flip-flop case ran in the full gateway suite.

runtime.brokerTopology: The gateway observes the gjc-owned per-agent-dir daemon. The first agent-dir-scoped sdk command auto-starts it; BrokerSupervisor owns the private agent directory and lock and probes sdk session list --scope cwd for a structural envelope whose result.sessions field is an array. Generation advances only after observed healthy recovery, and the retained Gen5 flip-flop case is included in the Gen6 full-suite evidence.
